evidence: The job-category landing page (careers.alaskaair.com/job-category/software-technology/jobs/) still loads its listing widget with 0 results as before, but the actual working search is at careers.alaskaair.com/jobs/?q=<query>. 'Software Engineer' returned 21 US postings, all Senior/Principal/Lead level (Senior Cloud Software Engineer, Principal Data Engineer, etc.); 'Software Engineer I' and 'early career technology' returned no matching postings. No new-grad or entry-level (0-1yr) SWE track found.
